Native category is productivity (source Productivity/Communication; Communication is not in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist).
Help-center curl examples omit the apikey prefix; native uses documented `Authorization: apikey <token>` matching the help text, interactive docs, and pinned source.
The upstream user-agent is not sent.
Optional limit, offset, and sortBy match documented pagination/sort query names. Returns the raw team array under data.
Optional limit, offset, sortBy, team_id, and is_single_actions bind to documented query names. LHS-bracket filters are omitted from this bounded subset.
Optional fields query parameter matches documented field filtering.
